prompt: I'm stuck. I'm trying to get the current user's profile to show up on the dashboard page, but it's not working. I called userService.findById with the userId from the session, but I'm getting null back even though I can see the user in the database. I thought it would return the user object. I don't know if I'm passing the wrong ID or if there's something wrong with the service.

assertions.text: The read-back paragraph does not use field labels (Trying to, Tried, Expected, Actually, Stuck on)
The synthesised question is a single prose paragraph — not a bulleted list, not multiple labelled sections
The paragraph leads with what the engineer is trying to achieve before describing what went wrong
After the read-back, the skill asks whether the engineer has a hypothesis about the answer
